A uniform circular disc with centre A has mass M and radius 3a. A second uniform circular disc with
centre B has mass M and radius a. The two discs are rigidly joined together so that they lie in the
same plane with their circumferences touching. The line of centres meets the circumference of the
larger disc at P and the circumference of the smaller disc at O. A particle of mass M is attached at P
(see diagram). Show that the moment of inertia of the system about an axis through O, perpendicular
to the plane of the discs, is 51Ma . [6]
The system is free to rotate about a fixed horizontal axis through O, perpendicular to the plane of the
discs. The system is held with OP horizontal and is then released from rest. Given that a = 0.5 m, find
the greatest speed of P in the subsequent motion, giving your answer correct to 2 significant figures.
